first.rationale: The two declining metrics (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the same funnel stage, and simplify_onboarding is the direction supported by two independent inherited records (memory_86 on shortening onboarding, memory_31 on cutting signup fields) with no recorded retention harm — the best fit for sustainable long-term qualified revenue. I am spending verification on exactly those two, because they are the load-bearing evidence for the action I intend to take, not on the options I am declining. They also warrant scrutiny: memory_31 is the oldest record here (day 12) and memory_86 reports adoption lift but says nothing about whether the lift persisted or about revenue quality, so both could be shallower than their summaries suggest. Promotional_pricing is the tempting reflex against the competitor's entry pricing, but memory_73 already carries an explicit caution — acquisition lift with materially reduced 30-day retention and a warning not to generalize — which directly conflicts with the sustainable-revenue objective; matching a price war would likely buy churning accounts. Activation_messaging (memory_91) is a reasonable second choice and could pair later, but it nudges accounts already inside the product rather than repairing the completion drop upstream. Referral_incentive and enterprise_sales_assist are sound but address neither declining metric this week. Key downstream risk to instrument, not just assume away: cutting signup fields and onboarding steps can shift the harm off the measured metric and onto lead qualification and routing quality — more activations of worse-fit accounts, degraded segmentation data, and weaker enterprise hand-off (memory_44's demo path depends on that data). So I will run this as a standard experiment with retention and downstream qualified-pipeline quality as explicit guardrail metrics over a 30-day window, not activation alone. If archive pulls show either record was short-horizon, small-n, or confounded with a concurrent change, I will downgrade to a small guarded test and reconsider activation_messaging. Both prior findings remain provisional until verified; the competitive pressure is real but it is a reason to act carefully, not a reason to treat unverified inherited claims as settled.
